method_card.title: Circuit Calculations
method_card.content:
Three equations cover this lesson.

Charge: Q = I × t (coulombs, amps, seconds).

Ohm's law: V = I × R. Rearrange to R = V ÷ I or I = V ÷ R first.

Series: same current everywhere; add the resistances.

Parallel: same pd across every branch; total resistance is less than the smallest branch.

steps: Find the total resistance from R = V ÷ I, then subtract known resistors to reach an unknown one.
In parallel, every branch has the full supply pd, so treat each branch on its own.
Some problems need two equations chained: charge to current, then Ohm's law.
